data.title: Income Tax Assessment for 2024 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbach issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024 for Jonas Mustermann, setting a back payment (Nachzahlung) of €1,236.00 due on 5 February 2026.
data.explanation: This letter is the final calculation of your 2024 income tax, solidarity surcharge and church tax. Based on your income of €64,380 and deductions, you owe a back payment of €1,236.00, due by 5 February 2026 — pay it by bank transfer to the Finanzamt's account using your Steuernummer as the payment reference. If you disagree with the calculation, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app will show until when based on the deadline shown. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final and binding. If the numbers seem wrong, consider consulting a tax advisor (Steuerberater).

remedy.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden. Der Einspruch ist beim Finanzamt Musterbach schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
